# eslee-folder-locker v1.2.3

- Resume re-lock failures are isolated per folder, with at most three attempts (30/60-second retry delays). Other due folders continue, and deadline changes are re-read within one second.
- Failure timestamps/results remain visible; credential-corruption protection and ACL recovery are preserved.
- Safe Core/App tests: 114 per language passed during audit verification. Twelve additional real Windows ACL/helper/recovery tests passed on disposable GUID fixtures, including exact SDDL restoration and a 10,101-item tree. All fixture folders were removed.
- PR CI runs safe Korean/English suites; privileged ACL acceptance is kept outside hosted CI. Installer execution and upgrade/uninstall UX were not performed on the user's existing installation.

Release assets include SHA-256 checksums and a manifest recording the exact source commit and successful release checks. A tag/source-version mismatch, missing asset or failed check stops publication. Existing releases are never overwritten.
